[LSCP.2.5.6] A multi-row **ambient relation** passes the containers
gate ([LCNT.2.1]),
on the same footing as the logical relation ([LLOG.2.7.4]): it is a
fact population matched individually by the engine's bounded,
non-authored match loop, not an author-iterable value. DS must not
grow a surface that hands the author the ambient row-set as a set or
cursor value. A `scope logical ambient` relation acquires keyed
identity from its `logical` base ([LFAC.1.7]) — the `key = all`
markers make distinct tuples distinct rows.
